svg.title: Sudoku in 12 passes
svg.desc: A hard Sudoku board solved by an independently trained MLX Next-Concept Modeling model in 12 passes. After pass 1 the grid is mostly wrong; after pass 12 it matches the solution.

g.text: REAL OUTPUT · hard board · one level per forward pass, coarse to fine · MLX
Independently trained 6.44M MLX NCM (sudoku-e19-funded), not the released HazyResearch checkpoint.
Board 1 of the upstream hard test set, greedy decoding, checkpoint SHA-256 843a8929c43a.
Each grid decodes the codes known after that pass; boxed cells differ from the solution. One board chosen by a fixed rule: fewest
givens among boards the model solves, ties by lowest index.
